verdict.rationale: Graphite ships its own command-line tool (`gt`), installable via Homebrew or npm, which can run outside the GUI. It also offers GT MCP, which lets AI agents create stacked PRs automatically, and AI reviews that run on every new PR without manual action. However, nothing documents using the CLI in CI pipelines, non-interactive or token-based auth, or a headless mode, and `gt config` is described as interactive. missing for 10: documented CI/headless usage, non-interactive auth for pipelines, CI examples or recipes, independent hands-on corroboration of CI automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The Graphite CLI is a tool to help you break up large engineering tasks into a series of small, incremental code changes directly from the command line.
Install the Graphite CLI using either Homebrew or npm
GT MCP allows AI agents to automatically create stacked PRs, breaking down large AI-generated changes into smaller, reviewable stacked pull requests.
Graphite Agent will now automatically review all new pull requests in the selected repositories
